spark.byteSummary:
Navigate unfamiliar multi-file codebases under time pressure: map entry points, trace data/state mutations, catch concurrency or logic bugs, and write safe fixes with tests.

Modern engineering loops increasingly replace pure LeetCode trivia with **Code Comprehension & Debugging** rounds where you inherit a realistic 300–1,000 line service with subtle race conditions, memory leaks.

Read top-down from the public entry point and tests first—never read every helper line-by-line before building a mental map of state ownership and side effects.

concept.whyItMatters: Modern engineering loops increasingly replace pure LeetCode trivia with **Code Comprehension & Debugging** rounds where you inherit a realistic 300–1,000 line service with subtle race conditions, memory leaks, off-by-one pagination bugs, or broken retry logic.
whenToUse: Code review, debugging, and codebase comprehension interviews.
Onboarding onto an unfamiliar production service or triaging an active incident.
whenNotToUse: Rewriting the entire codebase from scratch instead of diagnosing the root cause and applying a minimal, tested fix.
keyPoints: Step 1 (Entry-Point & Test Scan, 5m): Locate `main`/routes/controllers and existing unit tests to see intended contracts.
Step 2 (Data Flow & State Map, 10m): Trace where inputs enter, where state is mutated, and where external I/O (DB/cache/network) happens.
Step 3 (Bug Hunt Checklist): Check boundary conditions (`<` vs `<=`), shared mutable state without locks, unclosed resources, swallowed exceptions, and N+1 loops.
Step 4 (Reproduce -> Fix -> Verify): Write a failing reproduction test first, apply the minimal fix, and confirm all existing + new tests pass.

sections.content:
## Preparation & Execution Matrix

| Bug Category | Common Symptom in Code | Fix Strategy |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Concurrency** | Check-then-act on shared `dict`/`Map` | Atomic CAS, lock, or thread-safe collection |
| **Pagination / Offset** | Missing/duplicate items on concurrent writes | Keyset (cursor) pagination instead of `OFFSET` |
| **Resource Leak** | Unclosed streams/connections on exception | `with` context manager (Python) / `try-with-resources` (Java) |
| **Retry Storm** | Immediate tight-loop retries on 5xx | Exponential backoff + jitter + max attempts |
